obligations.description: - `WorktreeGitImprovement.md` still lacks a durable `worktree_record` / `worktree_projection` family, still has no explicit precedence rule between persisted runtime lineage and filesystem rediscovery, and still treats git-hook blocks and state files as if they could substitute for canonical blocked/runtime events.
exact_items: - `WorktreeGitImprovement.md` still lacks a durable `worktree_record` / `worktree_projection` family, still has no explicit precedence rule between persisted runtime lineage and filesystem rediscovery, and still treats git-hook blocks and state files as if they could substitute for canonical blocked/runtime events.
